summaries.Romania: Romania faces critical PNRR deadlines with €7.57B still at stake before August 31, while energy sector challenges mount as Dunărea hits 30-year lows and Metrorex struggles with unpaid bills. Constitutional Court decisions on electoral law and data transparency are reshaping governance amid controversy over political pressure.
summaries.Healthcare: Prior authorization denials hit 12-18% across major US insurers in 2025, while healthcare costs continue straining public-sector employers and rural maternity access deteriorates. Epic faces FTC antitrust investigation over data-sharing practices as the health tech landscape undergoes significant consolidation.
summaries.Tech: Apple's camera-equipped AirPods leak in official code suggesting imminent launch, while YouTube changes view counting, Reddit pilots AI-powered content formats, and major AI companies accelerate development cycles. Security vulnerabilities in macOS screen-sharing and spyware alerts affect unprecedented numbers of Apple users.

items.title: România, contra cronometru pentru banii din PNRR. 7,57 miliarde de euro mai pot fi încasate. Câte proiecte trebuie finalizate
items.snippet: România mai are două săptămâni pentru a finaliza investițiile și reformele asumate prin PNRR, înainte de termenul-limită de 31 august. Din bugetul actualizat de 20,1 miliarde de euro, aproximativ 7,57 miliarde de euro mai pot fi încasate, în timp ce aproximativ 4.500 de investiții nu sunt încă recep
items.line: Romania must finalize €7.57B in PNRR projects by August 31 or lose critical EU funding in what represents one of the highest-stakes deadlines for national development.

items.title: Avertisment venit de la vârful BNR: Suntem în fața unui semnal pe care România nu trebuie să-l ignore
items.snippet: Nivelul semnificativ mai redus al investiţiilor străine directe din primul semestru din 2026, comparativ cu aceeași perioadă a anului trecut, are trei explicaţii principale, legate de distribuţia dividendelor, reducerea profitabilităţii operaţionale (corelată cu încetinirea economiei) şi o conjunctu
items.line: BNR warns Romania's foreign direct investment plummeted 82% in H1 2026 versus 2025, signaling serious economic headwinds that demand urgent policy response.

items.title: Insurers denied between 12% to 18% of prior authorization requests in 2025: KFF
items.snippet: Researchers analyzed data from insurers in Medicare Advantage, Medicaid managed care and ACA Marketplace segments—representing approximately 71 million enrollees.
items.line: Insurers denied 12-18% of prior authorization requests in 2025 affecting 71M enrollees, highlighting systemic barriers to timely patient care across US health plans.

items.title: Epic faces Federal Trade Commission antitrust investigation, Reuters reports
items.snippet: The U.S. Federal Trade Commission has opened an antitrust investigation into Epic and is looking into its data-sharing practices, Reuters reported on Friday.
items.line: FTC opens antitrust investigation into Epic Systems over data-sharing practices, threatening the dominance of software used by majority of US hospitals.

items.title: AirPods with cameras get their clearest leak yet
items.snippet: Included in today’s macOS Tahoe 26.7 Release Candidate is a short video that appears to show Visual Intelligence in action on Apple’s rumored camera-equipped AirPods. Watch it below.
items.line: Camera-equipped AirPods appear in official macOS code with demonstration video, confirming Apple's imminent launch of Visual Intelligence wearables.

items.title: VIDEO Dunărea a atins la Galați cel mai mic nivel din ultimii 30 de ani, iar specialiștii anunță noi scăderi
items.snippet: Dunărea doboară record după record negativ. La Galați, nivelul fluviului este din ce în ce mai mic, în timp ce insula din mijlocul albiei se mărește. Mai mult, specialiștii anunță noi scăderi în următoarele zile.
items.line: Dunărea hits lowest level in 30 years at Galați with further declines forecast, threatening both energy production and regional stability during peak summer demand.

items.title: Apple va aplica o serie de modificări la o funcție de iPhone și iPad care a dus la reclamații și investigații în mai multe țări, inclusiv în România
items.snippet: Apple va modifica regulile care stabilesc modul în care dezvoltatorii de aplicații pot folosi datele personale pentru publicitatea țintită pe iPhone și iPad. Anunțul schimbării a fost făcut de companie, într-un briefing de presă, și vine după ce o autoritate germană a ajuns la o înțelegere cu compan
items.line: Apple agrees to modify App Tracking Transparency rules in Romania and Germany after regulatory pressure, setting precedent for EU enforcement of app privacy standards.

items.title: Rogobete: Pacienţii oncologici nu îşi găsesc medicamentele compensate pe care le-am introdus pe listă acum mai bine de patru luni
items.snippet: Fostul ministru al Sănătăţii Alexandru Rogobete afirmă, luni seară, că pacienţii oncologici nu îşi găsesc medicamentele compensate care au fost introduse pe listă acum mai bine de patru luni şi reclamă discontinuităţi, medicii fiind puşi în situaţia de a amâna sau modifica schemele terapeutice.
items.line: Cancer patients cannot find compensated medications introduced to reimbursement lists four months ago, exposing critical gaps in pharmaceutical supply chain management.

items.title: March of Dimes: Maternity care deserts persist, Medicaid cuts threaten to curb access further
items.snippet: A number of factors contribute to access, including the availability of OB clinicians, insurance coverage and access to birthing facilities.
items.line: Maternity care deserts persist across US with Medicaid cuts threatening to further reduce access, particularly impacting rural and underserved communities.

items.title: YouTube will now count a view as soon as a video starts playing
items.snippet: The change comes a year after YouTube applied the same approach to counting views on Shorts videos.
items.line: YouTube changes view counting to trigger on play-start rather than watch duration, likely inflating creator metrics and affecting ad valuation models.

items.title: A serious Mac screen sharing vulnerability is being actively exploited
items.snippet:
Apple recently released updates to three versions of macOS, stating that they fixed a serious screen sharing vulnerability in macOS Tahoe, Sequoia, and Sonoma.
At the time, there was no indication that the security flaw was being exploited in the wild, but now there is, so if you haven’t yet updated
items.line: macOS screen-sharing vulnerability now actively exploited in wild after Apple's recent patch, requiring immediate updates across Tahoe, Sequoia and Sonoma.

items.title: ‘Unprecedented’ number of Apple users received recent spyware alert, say investigators
items.snippet: Cybersecurity experts who investigate spyware attacks say the number of people who received a recent threat notification from Apple is unusually high.
items.line: Unprecedented number of Apple users received spyware alerts according to security researchers, suggesting either escalating attacks or improved detection capabilities.
